about: Work approved on 2026-11-15. One item per commit. Change only status, evidence, and commit; never delete or reword an item to make it pass. An item passes only when every check in done has been run and observed.

items.title: A child started outside any repository doesn't reserve every repository under it
done: A writer whose cwd is not inside a git repository (for example the home directory) no longer blocks writers in repositories beneath it, or the parent's edits there
Writers in the same non-repository directory still exclude each other
Unit test fails before the change
items.evidence: models: home and repository writers hold at once under the current rule and never under the old one; a writer in a plain directory under home still waits; 20,000-tree sweep with plain-directory roots all OK. test/admission.test.ts agreement with the model fails before (dir cases) and passes after. test/guard.test.ts: an edit in a repository under a plain-directory writer was refused before, allowed after; an edit in the plain directory itself is still refused. scripts/check.sh all pass, 159 tests.

items.title: /subagents release <run> frees the reservation of an uncertain launch
done: A run with no Rex tab and an unresolved process can be released after a confirmation, and its reservation member is gone
A run with a Rex tab, a live process, or a taken-over claim is refused, with the reason
The record says who released it and when
Unit test fails before the change
items.evidence: Corrected after an Opus review found 70cfd1f released runs still admitting or starting and recorded no 'who'. test/terminals.test.ts: release after confirmation removes the member and records released {at, by} with the process exited, and an older write keeps it; declining changes nothing; a known tab, a live process, a takeover, a launch still starting, and a launch still queued are each refused. The new cases failed on 70cfd1f. scripts/check.sh all pass, 172 tests.

items.title: An accepted message is never stranded as sent but unconsumed
done: models/protocol.py gains the failure (the send fails after the sent mark), the old rule fails it, and the new rule passes
A message whose send throws is sent again at the next drain
A sent message still unconsumed after a reporter reload is sent again
Unit test fails before the change
items.evidence: models/protocol.py: new transition 'Pi drops a queued message' and a check that every state finishes without outside help; nov14 (old rule) fails with 'reporter accepts m0 and steers -> Pi drops m0' stuck, current passes over 600 states. test/inbox.test.ts: TypeScript matches all 600 model states including 20 lost-message resends. test/reporter-poll.test.ts: a message sent before settlement and never consumed is sent again; failed before (0 sends), passes after (1). The reload case is the same rule: any sent, unconsumed message older than the latest settlement is resent. scripts/check.sh all pass, 165 tests.

items.title: Inspect reports changes inside a nested repository when the root is not a repository
done: Changing a nested repository's config, a hook, a ref, or HEAD reports changed with that path
Object stores are not hashed
Unit test fails before the change
items.evidence: test/fingerprint.test.ts: in a plain-directory root, changing a nested repository's config, a hook, a branch ref, and HEAD each report changed with that path; no fingerprint key is under .git/objects. Failed before (reported clean), passes after. scripts/check.sh all pass, 166 tests.

items.title: subagent_control wait returns when the named runs have outcomes
done: Waits for every named run the parent owns, or until a timeout, and reports each outcome capped like a result
An abort ends the wait without cancelling the runs
A background run reported by wait is not delivered again
Unit test and a harness scenario assertion
items.evidence: test/control.test.ts: waitForRuns returns an ended run's outcome, lists a running one as pending at a 300 ms timeout, and returns at once on abort without cancelling. test/delivery.test.ts: a subagent_control tool result counts as delivered (failed before). Harness control (HARNESS_MODEL=openai/gpt-6-luna because OpenCode Go's weekly limit was used up): a real parent model's wait with a 1 s timeout lists the held child as still running; a wait started before the child is released returns 'Run: <id> / Outcome: completed' with details.runIds, and no subagent-results delivery names the run 6 s later. Every other control part still passes. scripts/check.sh all pass, 168 tests.

items.title: A child that dies before starting says why
done: When a child exits without loading or claiming, the outcome includes the last lines of its terminal, such as Pi's own error
Unit test fails before the change

items.title: A read launch refuses a provider that only an extension provides
done: Launching access read with a provider registered by an extension, such as claude-bridge, is refused at launch with the reason and the alternative
Built-in providers still launch
Unit test fails before the change
items.evidence: test/launch.test.ts: with a fake pi that lists only anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 under --no-extensions, a read launch on bridge/claude-opus-5-5 is refused naming anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 and access inspect; a read launch on anthropic and a write launch on bridge are accepted. Failed before (the read launch was accepted). Costs one pi --list-models call (0.15-0.20 s measured) on read launches only. scripts/check.sh all pass, 170 tests.

items.title: placement: tab, float, or detached
done: float opens the child as a floating layer in the parent's window; detached keeps it running outside any window
Waiting, /subagents go, cancel, dismiss and auto-close still find the child by block ID
tab stays the default and unchanged
Harness scenario

items.title: worktree: true runs a writer in its own git worktree
done: Creates <repo-parent>/<repo>.worktrees/<label>-<id> on a new branch subagent/<label>-<id> from the checkout's HEAD, and runs the child there
Two worktree writers on one repository run at once
The result names the worktree and branch
A worktree is removed only when it is clean and its branch has no commits missing from another branch; otherwise it is kept and listed
Harness scenario

Harness scenario with a real dialog
